using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Orleans.Persistence.AdoNet;
using Orleans.Storage;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Persistence.AdoNet.Tests
{
    public class AdoNetGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorage_WithNameAndConfigureOptions_RegistersServices()
        {
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            var returnedServices = services.AddAdoNetGrainStorage("TestStorage", ob => ob.Configure(options =>
            {
                options.ConnectionString = "FakeConnectionString";
            }));

            // The returned IServiceCollection should be the same instance
            Assert.Same(services, returnedServices);

            // Build service provider to test resolution
            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            // Should be able to resolve IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>
            var optionsMonitor = provider.GetService<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>();
            Assert.NotNull(optionsMonitor);

            // Should be able to get named options
            var options = optionsMonitor.Get("TestStorage");
            Assert.NotNull(options);
            Assert.Equal("FakeConnectionString", options.ConnectionString);

            // Should be able to resolve IConfigurationValidator
            var validator = provider.GetService<IConfigurationValidator>();
            Assert.NotNull(validator);

            // Should be able to resolve IPostConfigureOptions<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>
            var postConfig1 = provider.GetService<IPostConfigureOptions<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>();
            Assert.NotNull(postConfig1);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault_UsesDefaultName()
        {
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            var returnedServices = services.AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault();

            Assert.Same(services, returnedServices);

            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            var optionsMonitor = provider.GetService<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>();
            Assert.NotNull(optionsMonitor);

            var options = optionsMonitor.Get(ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME);
            Assert.NotNull(options);

            var validator = provider.GetService<IConfigurationValidator>();
            Assert.NotNull(validator);
        }
    }
}
